verdict.rationale: Ledgy is a SaaS equity-management platform, so an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The pack documents only a GraphQL API with OAuth service-account authentication, and it contains no evidence of an official MCP server. The API is a developer building block, not the MCP capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
